subject: crtf-d
title: CRTF.D.------MT.INFO.
description: Diagram in WI-8. (C)CRTF-D (cross-transfer definitions) is crossed with MT-INFO (music information). The (c) on cross-transfer-definitions is critical: this is the *concept* of cross-transfer definitions — the institutional mechanism by which a piece of source-initiated music gets re-defined when it transfers across cultural lines. The diagram poses what music information looks like when crossed with that conceptual mechanism. CRTF-D → MT-INFO (the crossing) and CRTF-D → EXT-DYM (expansion dynamics). MT-INFO branches to ALT-D (alternative definitions) and (R)INT (the reality of intention). (R)INT then forks into AFN (affinity negation) and APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions). EXT-DYM branches to AFTF (affinity transfer) and ALT-C-PG (alternative composite progressionalism). Structural argument: when cross-transfer definitions cross music information, the *real intention* of the original music becomes available for two opposite outcomes — affinity negation (rejection-as-foreign) or applied redefinition (institutional capture). The expansion-dynamics output produces affinity transfer and alternative composite progressionalism — two more constrained outcomes. The diagram thus diagrams the white-improvisor section's diagnostic claim: a piece of music routed through cross-transfer definitions does not arrive intact; the route through reality-of-intention bifurcates into rejection or applied-redefinition, exactly the two outcomes Braxton names as the ways black creativity has been processed by the white interpretive apparatus.
